opengwasr

Source: GLOSSARY.md

The R interface to OpenGWAS data: it queries GWAS Stores and LD Stores through the OpenGWAS API or from Store Releases you have downloaded, and hands the results to analytical tools such as TwoSampleMR. Data terms are taken unchanged from opengwasdb and ogld, and terms that cross repositories from og-dev-hub’s CONTEXT.md; this glossary defines them only as far as opengwasr users meet them.

Data (from opengwasdb and ogld)

Analysis: One statistical analysis of one Trait, producing Associations between that Trait and Variants. Avoid: GWAS, study, dataset, GWAS id

Association: The statistics linking one Variant to one Analysis. Avoid: hit, result, row

GWAS Store: Short for OpenGWAS GWAS Store: a published, versioned collection of harmonised GWAS summary statistics holding one or more Analyses, with an OGS-* id (opengwasdb’s “Store”). Avoid: bare “Store”, batch, database, dataset

Store Release: An immutable, published version of a GWAS Store; every Association a user receives comes from exactly one. Avoid: version, snapshot

Stored Effect Scale: The scale an Analysis’s effects are expressed on: SD units for continuous traits, log odds for binary ones. Avoid: units, original scale

ALID: A variant’s identity, chromosome:position:A1:A2 on GRCh38: alleles of one length in alphabetical order, an indel’s reference allele first. A1 is the effect allele. Avoid: SNP id, variant id, chrpos

Rho Matrix: The null correlation (sample overlap times phenotypic correlation) between every pair of Analyses in a GWAS Store with a Dense Layout. Avoid: genetic correlation, overlap matrix

Indexed Variant Subset: A named, standard set of variants, such as HapMap3, at which a GWAS Store holds every Analysis’s Associations for fast extraction. Avoid: SNP list, projection

Reference-Completed: Describes a Store Release that, beyond the Associations its sources reported, holds Imputed Associations for the variants they did not report. Avoid: imputed store, filled

Association Status: Whether an Association is Observed (reported by the source), Imputed (added by Reference Completion) or Missing. Avoid: proxy, source flag

LD Store: Short for OpenGWAS LD Store: the published LD of one reference panel of one ancestry on one Reference Assembly, used for clumping, LD Proxies and LD matrices. Not a kind of GWAS Store. Avoid: bare “Store”, LD panel, LD reference, bfile

Far Threshold (t_far): The r² an LD Store’s pairs 3 to 10 Mb apart must reach for it to hold their r; below it, it knows only that r² is below t_far. Avoid: r² threshold, clumping threshold (both name a request’s r2)

LD Proxy: A variant in LD with a given variant, found by looking it up in an LD Store. opengwasr never substitutes one’s Association for a missing Association. Avoid: proxy Association

Assigned Ancestry: The single super-population label of an Analysis, inferred from its allele frequencies; an Analysis that matches no single ancestry confidently is Unassigned. Avoid: population, reported ancestry

PLINK Reference: A user-supplied PLINK binary genotype fileset used for LD operations on the user’s own machine. Its LD is computed from its genotypes without adjusting for population structure (principal components), unlike an LD Store’s or a Genotype Store’s, so it may be less accurate. Avoid: bfile, LD Store, LD panel

Genotype Store: Short for OpenGWAS Genotype Store: the published genotypes of one reference panel of one ancestry, from which LD is computed when it is asked for, rather than read precomputed as from an LD Store. Neither the API nor opengwasr serves one yet. Avoid: genotype panel, bfile, LD Store

LD resource: Where a Source’s LD comes from: an LD Store, a Genotype Store or a PLINK Reference, on the API or on the user’s machine. A Source carries at most one (og_api(ld_store = ), og_local(bfile = )); without one, the API Source lets each Analysis’s Assigned Ancestry choose its LD Store, and a Local Source has none. It is chosen only on the Source: other LD for one call is another Source (og_api(inherit = src, ld_store = )). Avoid: LD reference, LD panel, LD source

Clumps: The index variants of an Analysis’s top hits, each standing for the weaker top hits in LD with it, together with the configuration that made them: the LD resource, r2 and kb. Stored Clumps are made when a Store Release is built: its 5e-8 top hits, clumped with each ancestry’s default LD resource and its r2 and kb, and used only when a request matches that configuration exactly. Any other Clumps are computed on the fly. Provenance says which. Avoid: clumped hits, independent hits, pruned variants

LD Reference Panel: opengwasdb’s internal LD data used to complete GWAS Stores at build time; never queried by opengwasr users. Avoid: LD Store

Access

Source: Where a query is answered: either the API Source or a Local Source. Every query names one. A Source also carries the LD resource that answers LD for its Associations. Avoid: backend, connection, server

API Source: The OpenGWAS API, reached over the network, suited to small queries.

Legacy OpenGWAS: The OpenGWAS service in production today, which ieugwasr calls, until OpenGWAS replaces it. Avoid: the old API, bare “OpenGWAS” for that service

Local Source: Store Releases downloaded to the user’s own machine, suited to large queries. One made with only a PLINK Reference (og_local(bfile = )) answers LD only, for data the user already has. Avoid: offline mode, local files

GWAS Store directory: The directory holding one GWAS Store’s Store Release, one level down, as og_local() reads it: the directory there holding a manifest.json (hidden directories skipped). Several Store Releases there are refused, never chosen between. Avoid: store folder, release root

Job: A query submitted to the API Source that is queued and later collected, rather than answered immediately. Avoid: request, task

Store Reader: The single library through which every consumer reads a Store Release. That library is ogquery. Avoid: query engine, opengwasdb (for the reading part)
